title: Completed Output UI hardening
summary: Hardens the Completed Output WebView tab with persistent selected-output context, explicit stale/loading reconciliation proof, visible promotion gating, stronger final-placement severity, scannable history proof strips, and evidence-copy feedback.
reason: The Completed Output audit found that selected context, proof freshness, blocked promotion reasons, and evidence-copy/reconciliation feedback could be misread during operator trust decisions.
behavior_before: Completed subtabs could lose visible selected-output context; publish reconciliation could remain visually loaded after Completed refresh; promotion disabled reasons relied heavily on title text; missing drain-proof placement used a weaker changed state; copy feedback and empty-packet state were not fully explicit.
behavior_after: Completed subtabs keep a selected-output context bar; Completed refresh invalidates reconciliation as not loaded or stale; reconciliation loading/error/stale states render explicitly; promotion controls show visible blocked/confirmable reasons; missing drain-proof placement is warning severity; evidence copy disables empty packets and reports success/failure through live status text.
manual_validation: node --check touched Completed WebView JS modules - passed
rollback_plan: Revert the WebView static markup/JS/CSS changes and the three smoke-test extensions in this packet; no backend API, media policy, manifest, publish, drain, queue, rename, or filesystem behavior was changed.
notes:

Validation passed for syntax checks and requested no-mutation browser smokes.
